Name: Nimrod
Summary: Nimrod was a son of Cush and the first mighty ruler after the flood. He founded Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, and built Nineveh.
KeyStory: Nimrod became known as a mighty hunter before the LORD, and his kingdom was the beginning of empire in the ancient world.
LifeLesson: Power without God builds towers that fall; greatness is measured by faithfulness, not dominion.
